description: Opens a pg_dump file from a chat link as a database you can browse and query, with no server, Docker or psql. Agents in the thread can list its tables and run read-only PostgreSQL queries on it, so their answers come from the dump. Replays plain and tar dumps, gzip, zstd or lz4 compressed, into a PostgreSQL that runs as WebAssembly in the panel, and draws an ER diagram from the foreign keys. The dump is never uploaded. Exporting the diagram, or more than 10,000 rows of a result, needs DBConvert PRO ($9 a month).
